Metadata.defaultTitle: INVICSOL — turnkey solar stations in Lviv
Metadata.defaultDescription: Design, installation, and service for solar stations in Lviv and the region. Grid-tied and hybrid systems, backup power, and green-tariff support.

Hero.description: We design, install, and service grid-tied and hybrid solar stations in Lviv and the region. Kit prices up front; the exact installation figure after a free site visit.
